greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
psalm_response: Phakamisani iintloko zenu, kuba intlangulo yenu isondele.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntwana encinane, esandula ukubona inqwelo-moya ifika kwisikhululo, amehlo akhe ekhazimla kwaye ebuza imibuzo engapheliyo. KuBenjamin Vo, loo mzuzu wawungengomdlalo nje; wawungumzamo wokubona ngaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi, ukufikelela kwizinto ezinkulu, ezintsha, nezikhanyayo. Wayengumfana owayehlala ejonge phambili, owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukuqonda imfihlelo yezinto ezinzima, kodwa intliziyo yakhe yayisala isengumntwana ongenakhethileyo, ogcwele uthando olumsulwa. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, uYohane usibonisa umbono onamandla: 'Iyeza ixesha lokuvuna, kuba isivuno somhlaba sivuthiwe.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Isivuno sivuthiwe. Kwiingqondo zethu, sicinga ngesivuno njengento elungileyo, kodwa xa sijongene nokulahleka komntwana, loo mazwi anokuvakala ebuhlungu. Kodwa uThixo akavuni nje ngenxa yokuthatha; uvuna ngenxa yokuba uthando lwakhe lufuna ukugcina okuxabisekileyo kwindawo apho kungekho ntlungu, kungekho zifo, kwaye kungekho mda.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha ngesikhathi esinzima. Uthi: 'Kukho iimpawu elangeni, nasenyangeni, nasezinkwenkwezini, kwaye emhlabeni iintlanga ziya kuba sezingxakini.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Iintlanga ziya kuba sezingxakini. Ngaba wakha waziva ngolo hlobo? Xa intlungu ikubambile, xa usizi luthatha indawo yovuyo, uvakalelwa kukuba uvalelwe entolongweni yosizi. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo, ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, intliziyo yenu ikhumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen wayesemncumile, ehleka, kwaye esenza amaphupha akhe abe yinyani. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho nibuzayo ukuba kutheni, kwaye kutheni ngoku. Kodwa namhlanje, ndifuna ukususa elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu. UBen akazange agule ngenxa yokuba kukho into eniyenzileyo okanye eningayenzanga. Akukho nto niyiphosileyo. Iziphithiphithi zeli hlabathi, izifo, kunye neentlungu, zizinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye uBen akakubeki icala. UBen wayenothando olungagungqiyo kuni, kwaye uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lukhanya.

UYesu uthi: 'Phakamisani iintloko zenu, kuba intlangulo yenu isondele.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Phakamisani iintloko zenu. Oku akuthethi ukuba asinakuphulukana nemizimba yethu. Kuthetha ukuba phambi kukaThixo, akukho nto ilahlekileyo. Yonke into oyithandayo, yonke into oyinikileyo, yonke into oyikhumbulayo ngoBen, igcinwe ngokupheleleyo. UBen akalahlekanga. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. 

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci. 

Khumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen, eseneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, wathetha nabazali bakhe etsheho ukuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayesandula ukuhlaselwa zizifo ezimbini. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kwaye yayingafuneki ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-insurance, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku. 

Alan noThao, nina bafazi namadoda abathandayo uBen, nina Ryan, mfowethu kaBen, hlalani neli themba. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci. 

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene ekuNgcweleni kweSikhumbuzo. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, ndize ndizimanye nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Makusikelele uThixo uSomandla, uYise, noNyana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanjeni lwakhe uKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abakhathazekileyo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndabona esinye isithunywa sisihla ezulwini, sinobugunya obukhulu, umhlaba wakhanyiswa bubungangamsha baso. Sadanduluka ngezwi elikhulu sisithi: 'Iwele, iwele iBhabheli enkulu. Ibe yindawo yokuhlala iidemon. Ibe yindlu yayo yonke imimoya engcolileyo, yayo yonke intaka engcolileyo, yayo yonke isilwanyana esingcolileyo nesinyanyekayo.' Isithunywa esinamandla sathatha ilitye elifana nelitye lokusila elikhulu, lasiphosa elwandle, sathi: 'Ngamandla anjalo iBhabheli, isixeko esikhulu, iya kuphoswa phantsi, kwaye ayisayi kuze ifumaneke kwakhona. Akusayi kuphinda kuvakale kuyo imiculo yabaculi, neyeempempe, neyeempondo. Akusayi kuphinda kufumaneke kuyo umsebenzi wamagcisa. Akusayi kuphinda kuvakale kuyo isandi selitye lokusila. Akusayi kuphinda kubonwe kuyo ukukhanya kwesibane. Akusayi kuphinda kuvakale kuyo amazwi omfazi nomyeni. Kuba abathengisi bakho bebengabakhulu behlabathi, kwaye zonke iintlanga zilahlekiswe ngamayeza akho.' Emva koku ndeva izwi elivakala ngathi yingxolo yezihlwele ezininzi ezulwini, zisithi: 'Alleluia! Usindiso, uzuko, namandla ngakaThixo wethu, kuba zigwebo zakhe ziyinyani kwaye zilungile. Ugwebe ihenyukazi elikhulu elonakalise umhlaba ngobhenyukazi balo. Uphindisele kulo igazi labakhonzi bakhe.' Baphinda okwesibini: 'Alleluia! Umsi uya kunyuka uvela kulo ngonaphakade kanaphakade.' Emva koko isithunywa sathi kum: 'Bhala oku: Banoyolo abo babiziweyo kwisidlo somtshato seMvana.'

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: 'Xa nibona iYerusalem irhangqwe yimikhosi, yazini ukuba intshabalalo yayo isondele. Ngoko abo baseYudiya mababalekele ezintabeni. Mabaphume abo bangaphakathi kwesixeko, kwaye abo basesemaphandleni mabangangeni esixekweni, kuba ezi ntsuku lixesha loqeqesho apho zonke izibhalo ziya kuzaliseka. Yeha abafazi abakhulelweyo nabo bancancisayo ngaloo mihla, kuba intlekele enkulu iya kuza emhlabeni kunye nesigwebo somsindo phezu kwaba bantu. Baya kuwa ngomkhonto kwaye baya kuthinjwa bayiswe kuzo zonke iintlanga; kwaye iYerusalem iya kuxhatshazwa ziintlanga de ixesha leentlanga lizaliseke. Kuya kubakho iimpawu elangeni, nasenyangeni, nasezinkwenkwezini, kwaye emhlabeni iintlanga ziya kuba sezingxakini, zixakekile kukugquma kolwandle namaza. Abantu baya kufa kukoyika ngenxa yezinto eziza kwehla emhlabeni, kuba amandla ezulu aya kunkwantyiswa. Kwaye ngoko baya kumbona uNyana woMntu esiza efini ngamandla nangozuko olukhulu. Kodwa xa ezi mpawu ziqala ukwenzeka, phakamisani iintloko zenu kuba intlangulo yenu isondele.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
